text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hot springs town, I have arrived!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, using the hot spring trip ticket won from the lottery earlier,
they were visiting a hot spring town.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What we're looking for, of course, is—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the hot springs! The hot springs!
When our unification of the realm is finally achieved—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now, let us head to the secret hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right, a hidden spring! It refers to hot springs
said to have been owned and used by Sengoku warlords long ago."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Hidden hot springs originally played a major role
as places for healing and treatment, you see."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
For soldiers exhausted in both mind and body from fighting through the war,
a truly one-of-a-kind place of solace—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! We must pull ourselves together
and enter with full vigor!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As one who has raced through the Twinkle Series,
I shall humbly accept this well-earned respite!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Here we go~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Whew, it went right in!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That thick, cloudy bath was heavenly!
Warmed me right down to the core!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: And so, on to the next!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Since we went through the trouble of coming here,
it'd be boring if we didn't milk it for all it's worth!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"The hidden springs of this land—
Nay, I shall soak in every single hot spring there is~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm toasty warm, I am!
Free-flowing hot springs! And the milk is downright delicious too!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Next up is that hidden hot spring over there!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*...!
Man, I really got way too into it!
choice_data_list: If you're struggling, let's take a little break.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fool, time and tide wait for no one!
Pay it no mind, onward! Forward we go!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...!
Goodness, my whole body is just burning up—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Bleh.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Forgive me, I got a bit too carried away playing!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Let's head back to the inn quickly.
It'd be a shame to catch a chill after the bath."
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Can you walk?
Are you okay? Can you walk?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmph, who do you take me for?! I am the fierce Umamusume who boldly charged through the Sengoku period of the racing world—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Abya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I ended up carrying No Reason on my back
as we headed back to the inn.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
..................Forgive me.
To think I would cause such trouble during our travels.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Messing up because she got carried away playing around.
I wonder if even she is reflecting on her actions.
choice_data_list: Things like this happen. You're exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is no exaggeration. Had you not been here,
I might have had no choice but to crawl along the ground.
Overcome by helplessness... I might have been reduced to tears.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Does that hold true for the Twinkle Series as well, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
When all is said and done,
I'm just an Umamusume whose only merits are sheer momentum and cunning.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Dreams like conquering the realm and showing the world
how to live... cannot be achieved alone...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I could never have achieved it without this back.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Lord <username>.
...Heheh, it's rather embarrassing to say face-to-face.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: And so, is it about time?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There we go! Ah, what a splendid ride that was!
Well done, well done!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho!
Never underestimate an Umamusume's stamina.
I had already recovered quite a while ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her words make me pause with a start. Could it be... the whole reason she gave me that lovely pep talk while giving me a piggyback was—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now then, whatever are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, look! Tonight shall be
a merry, magnificent cola banquet!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let us raise our glasses of cola high,
and speak of our future to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyah-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (—Just kidding!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with No Reason...
